collaboration.scope: Focused peer review of the seven Gets Hot formal pages, its one-variant/two-binding map entry, the reverse Plasma Gun README, and the existing evidence relevant to RAW, formatter, tiers, heat steps, damage, shot timing, and image.
findings: The updated probability example states critical_strike_chance_to_damage_convert=0 and excludes other guaranteed or prevented critical hits. Under those assumptions, 20% + 50 percentage points at tier IV/five heat steps + 5 percentage points from ordinary ranged handling = 75% before the game critical check; the text distinguishes this input from one-percent rounding and PRD.

Tier values, the five-step heat rule and boundaries, wrapper conditional override, and the empty optional stepped table agree with the existing fixed-SHA evidence; no extra one-percent increment or duplicate conditional application is implied.

Ranged critical damage changes only the critical Finesse extra portion. A critical weakspot hit uses one merged base_finesse_damage, and the three numerical examples correctly demonstrate the one-third share, one-half share, and additive same-stage c=0.25 case.

The timing explanation places the ordinary and charged single-shot critical check before that shot adds heat, includes ordinary ranged handling's five percentage points, and avoids promising retroactive heat or an unverified same-frame reset. Special, vent, reload, and switching claims remain qualified to the checked source evidence; no FASTER behavior is asserted.

Exact RAW name/description and hash are kept separate from static formatter reconstruction. The comparison correctly calls out the RAW “up to” wording versus runtime per-step accumulation and its five-step maximum.

The map's single Gets Hot variant uses weapon_id plasmagun_p1 and binds plasmagun_p1_m1 and plasmagun_p1_m2; both actual inventory marks are linked from the reverse Plasma Gun README. The icon resource path and attachment URL are separate, and the existing image receipt supports the display.
